items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Adderly's Cannonball's father was in that.

ctx.x: They would have the contest in Chicago and Detroit. Detroit was the Greystone Ballroom, of course. Every year and Rex Stewart playing with the Wilberforce Collegians, they would be in it. But Edwards Collegians had 9 pieces and they don't know who won the contest.
Edwards Collegians, Belton's Syncopators out of Florida... Adderly's Cannonball's father was in that. //And they were like this.
What band was Cannonball's father in?
